elaine: Proposal — add 'variance_bucket' + optional raw_score to rerank response so console histograms and QoS alerts can use a compact discrete distribution. also want a sticky routing hint for canary so a user/session consistently hits the same model variant. thoughts? @pj :eyes:

pj: +1 on buckets for dashboards. keep buckets as small ints (e.g. 0..9) derived from normalized raw_score. include an optional `raw_score` when `detail=true` for evals. sample response idea:
```json
{
  \"candidates\": [
    {\"id\": \"c1\", \"variance_bucket\": 7, \"raw_score\": 0.872, \"cost_units\": 0.012 },
    {\"id\": \"c2\", \"variance_bucket\": 5, \"cost_units\": 0.009 }
  ],
  \"model_variant\": \"rwd-v2-quant\",
  \"sticky_hint\": \"session-ttl:300s\"
}
```
We can use `cost_units` for billing/quotas so buckets don't accidentally change charge semantics.
marta: Agree on `cost_units`. Two concerns: 1) if we bucket we lose small shifts that might indicate regressions — need per-route evasion tests (store raw on evals). 2) Console needs to surface distribution *and* the outlier tail (top0.1%). Buckets + reservoir sample of raw scores should do.
ciaran: For sticky routing: we already have `x-client-session` header in some product clients. Policy idea: if header present, map session -> model_variant using a small consistent-hash table with TTL. On node failover fallback to `fallback_variant` and emit telemetry: `sticky_evicted=true`. Pseudo: 
```pseudo
if session_id:
  variant = lookup_sticky(session_id) or pick_canary_variant()
  assign_sticky(session_id, variant, ttl)
else:
  variant = pick_by_policy()
```
Also: add route rule for latency spikes: if p95 > threshold -> route new sessions to cheaper variant but keep existing stickies intact.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout created: canary=rwd-v3-experimental pct=5 created by elaine at 3412351200. :rocket:
elaine: For telemetry tags I propose minimal set: `model_variant`, `variance_bucket`, `session_id_hash`, `candidate_count`, `route_decision` (canary|fallback|default). these should be indexed in metrics for fast aggregation.
pj: Backcompat: default response must keep `score` (float) for older consumers; introduce `variance_bucket` and `cost_units` as additive. payload size: prefer int buckets + omit `raw_score` unless `detail=true`. we should version this as `response_schema: v2` in header so SDKs can adapt.
marta: Console UX notes: heatmap showing bucket distribution over time, per-tenant slider to change alert thresholds, and an anomaly alert if median bucket shifts > 1 bucket over a day. also surface sticky-fallback counts next to rollout % so PMs see how many sessions were evicted.
elaine: ok thanks — action items: pj to draft response schema PR, ciaran to prototype sticky mapping implementation + eviction telemetry, marta to mock console panels. i'll wire up the canary in staging after schema PR. :thumbsup:
